title: Retro is back.
old_caption:
Got a confusing text that reads like a riddle?
Don't spend all night decoding it. When in doubt, call.

title: Retro is on the road trip.
old_caption:
Ever been tempted to turn around and drive back toward an ex?
Virgo has the map. Going back is not the same as going forward.

title: Retro hit the ballot box.
old_caption:
What if your past tried to sneak onto the ballot?
Retro tries a rewind, but the only option here is forward.

title: Retro apologizes.
old_caption:
What does a real apology sound like?
Not "sorry you feel that way." Retro writes "i did that, i'm sorry," learns something, and looks forward.

title: Texas, then where?
old_caption:
Matched with someone from the rival city?
Being different is fine. Being curious is a start.

title: The road trip ends.
old_caption:
One of you drove the whole way, the other planned it?
Virgo and Sagittarius have different strengths and one direction: home.

title: The stars are going on a road trip.
old_caption:
Who in your crew handles snacks, music, the map and the driving?
The stars pack the van and leave Houston for the rest of Texas.

title: Road trip: San Antonio
old_caption:
Do you plan the whole wedding in your head on the first boat ride?
Pisces lets the daydream go and enjoys right now. This moment is the plan.

title: Saturn's class
old_caption:
Do you know what you actually want in love?
Saturn says not knowing yet is fine. Figuring it out is your homework.

title: Saturn's class: how to apologize.
old_caption:
Ever said sorry and then added a but?
Saturn's lesson: say what you did and what you will change. Drop the but.
